title: General Translation Configuration
description: Configuration schema for gt.config.json files used by General Translation CLI

defaultLocale.description: The default locale for your project. This is the locale that your source content is written in and serves as the fallback locale.

locales.description: An array of locales for your project. These are the locales that you want to translate your project into.

customMapping.description: Custom locale properties by locale code. A string overrides the display name; an object overrides properties, and its code makes the locale an alias, such as { "cn": { "code": "zh" } }

localeMatcher.description: How requested locales are matched to your locales. "best fit" runs RFC 4647 Lookup within each requested language, then accepts a locale of the same language and script. "lookup" is strict RFC 4647 Lookup.

enableI18n.description: Set to false to render only the default locale

localeRouting.description: Enable framework-provided locale path routing when supported

prefixDefaultLocale.description: Prefix the default locale to the pathname, i.e. /about -> /en/about

enableSmartRouting.description: Keep automatic locale negotiation. Disable to treat returning visitors' unprefixed URLs as default-locale routes.

routeOverrides.description: Locale-relative paths to rewrite from /{locale}/{path} to /{locale}/{locale}/{path}

localeRoutes.description: Shared paths available per locale; other paths fall back to the default locale

pathRegex.description: Regular expression source that limits i18n middleware routing by pathname, written for paths without the locale prefix. <Link>, useLocalizeHref() and getLocalizeHref() leave non-matching paths unprefixed.

disableInvalidLocaleWarning.description: Disable warnings about invalid request locales

projectId.description: The project ID for your General Translation project

apiKey.description: Use the GT_API_KEY environment variable instead of storing an API key in this file

_versionId.description: Internal version identifier for the configuration

_branchId.description: Internal branch identifier for the configuration

runtimeUrl.description: Runtime URL for the General Translation service. Set to null or an empty string to disable runtime translation.

cacheUrl.description: URL for cached translations. Set to null to disable.

cacheExpiryTime.description: How long translations are cached, in milliseconds

modelProvider.description: AI model provider to use for translations

maxConcurrentRequests.description: Maximum number of concurrent translation requests

maxBatchSize.description: Maximum translation requests in the same batch

batchInterval.description: Interval between batched translation requests, in milliseconds

renderSettings.description: How content renders while a translation loads

_disableDevHotReload.description: Disable development hot reload of translations

_tagIds.description: Opt-in id-tagging, off by default. When true, each <T>'s translation hash is exposed on the DOM as a data-_gt-hash attribute so tooling (localized replay, in-context QA) can map a rendered node back to its published translation. No effect on gt() string translations; DOM-only (skipped on React Native). This injects markup: a <T> that renders bare text or a fragment has no element to hold the attribute, so its output is wrapped in a layout-neutral display:contents <span>. It is never enabled implicitly.

dictionary.description: Optional string that specifies the relative path to the dictionary file

loadTranslationsPath.description: Path to a custom loadTranslations file

loadDictionaryPath.description: Path to a custom loadDictionary file

getLocalePath.description: Path to a custom getLocale function

getRegionPath.description: Path to a custom getRegion function

description.description: Description of the project or configuration

output.description: Output path pattern with [locale] placeholder for saving translations locally

publish.description: Publish GT translation files to the CDN

autoderive.description: Treat interpolated and concatenated values as derive() calls. true or false applies to JSX and strings; the object form enables each separately.

includeSourceCodeContext.description: Include surrounding source code lines as context for translations

devHotReload.description: Translate new content at runtime during development. true or false applies to JSX and strings; the object form enables each separately.

viteConfigPath.description: Vite config path relative to the project root

files.description: Configuration for different file types that you want to translate

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for this configuration file

baseUrl.description: Base URL for the General Translation API

dashboardUrl.description: URL for the General Translation dashboard

stageTranslations.description: Optional boolean flag that indicates whether your project is configured to use human review

requiresReview.description: When true, translated files require approval before the CLI downloads and uses them. File-type requiresReview settings and component-level $requiresReview props override this default.

omitConfigIds.description: Do not write _versionId or _branchId to gt.config.json

src.description: Optional array of relative directory paths that contain translatable content

framework.description: The framework being used in the project

version.description: Custom version ID to use for translations. Should be unique

include.description: Glob or array of globs (repo-root relative) that match static assets to consolidate (e.g., 'docs/**/*.{png,jpg,svg}').

outDir.description: Repo-root relative output directory where assets will be placed (on disk). Examples: 'public/shared', 'static/img', 'shared'. Required unless mirrorToLocales is true.

publicPath.description: Public URL prefix to use in rewritten content. If omitted, it is derived from outDir (public/* → '/…', static/* → '/…', otherwise '/basename(outDir)').

mirrorToLocales.description: When true, copy matched assets to the equivalent location in each locale directory instead of centralizing them. This preserves relative paths in translated files. outDir and publicPath are ignored.

sharedStaticAssets.description: Configuration for moving shared static assets to a single directory and rewriting references in source files, or mirroring assets to each locale directory.

include.description: Globs of .ttf and .otf font files

fonts.description: Fonts to sync to the API before translating

resolveRefs.description: Resolve $ref entries in this file before processing

include.description: Array of JSONPaths to include (mutually exclusive with composite)
Array of relative JSONPaths to include in the translated JSON

key.description: Relative JSONPath to the key to distinguish between source and target locales (required for array type)

localeProperty.description: Specific locale property to use for the key for target locales

transform.description: Optional config for transforming specific fields in the source item

omitProperties.description: Top-level properties to remove from generated non-default-locale entries

experimentalSort.description: Optional sorting behavior for array type. When set to 'locales', items are ordered to match your locales array. When set to 'localesAlphabetical', the default locale stays first and the remaining locales are sorted alphabetically by locale code.

splitEntries.description: Extract non-default keyed entries into separate files and replace them with $ref pointers

additionalProperties.description: Source object options for this JSONPath
JSON schema options for files matching this glob pattern

jsonSchema.description: JSON schema configuration for specific file globs

include.description: Array of YAML paths to include for translation

transform.description: Optional config for transforming specific fields

additionalProperties.description: YAML schema options for files matching this glob pattern

yamlSchema.description: YAML schema configuration for specific file globs

skipFileValidation.description: Skip pre-parse validation for specific file types before sending content to the translation pipeline.

files.description: Ordered list of OpenAPI spec files (JSON only). Earlier entries win when resolving ambiguities.

translateFields.description: JSONPaths to translate within OpenAPI specs.

openapi.description: OpenAPI localization settings for Mintlify. Framework defaults to mintlify.

inferTitleFromFilename.description: Add a frontmatter title derived from the file name to MDX pages that have none.

localizeRedirects.description: Add localized copies of English redirects for pages renamed or removed in a translate run. Uses docsUrlPattern and experimentalHideDefaultLocale to place the locale.

docsUrlPattern.description: Pattern for localizing static URLs in markdown files (e.g., '/docs/[locale]' or '/[locale]'). Use a list to localize several URL prefixes; each URL uses the longest pattern it matches.

docsImportPattern.description: Pattern for localizing static imports in markdown files (e.g., '/docs/[locale]/foo.md' or '/[locale]/foo.md')

excludeStaticUrls.description: Glob patterns of URLs to leave unlocalized; [locale] matches the default locale

excludeStaticImports.description: Glob patterns of import paths to leave unlocalized; [locale] matches the default locale

docsImportRewrites.description: Explicit rewrites for import prefixes before pattern-based localization (e.g., map '@site/docs' to '@site/i18n/[locale]/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current')

docsHideDefaultLocaleImport.description: If true, hide the default locale in the import path

copyFiles.description: Array of files to copy to the target locale

experimentalLocalizeStaticImports.description: Inserts locale in static import paths in md/mdx files

skipUntranslatedPages.description: Keep links to source pages that have no translation on the default locale. Assumes URLs mirror source file paths and missing localized pages return a 404, as on Mintlify. Leave off for sites that serve untranslated pages at the localized URL, such as Docusaurus.

attributes.description: Extra JSX attribute names or glob patterns whose URLs are localized, such as "href2" or "href*". "href" is always localized. Avoid patterns that match asset attributes like "src", since shared assets would 404 with a locale prefix.

experimentalLocalizeStaticUrls.description: Inserts locale in static url paths in md/mdx files and adds anchor IDs to preserve navigation. Use the object form to enable it with extra behavior.

experimentalLocalizeRelativeAssets.description: Rewrites relative image asset URLs in translated md/mdx files to valid paths

experimentalAddHeaderAnchorIds.description: Format for heading anchor IDs: 'mintlify' for Mintlify's native {#id} on every heading, 'default' for escaped inline \{#id\}. Can run without static URL localization.

experimentalHideDefaultLocale.description: Hides the default locale in the import path

experimentalFlattenJsonFiles.description: Flattens JSON files into a single file

experimentalCanonicalLocaleKeys.description: For composite JSON schemas with locale keys, use the canonical locale even when an alias is provided

saveLocal.description: Detect and save local edits to translated output before enqueuing translations.

baseDomain.description: The base http:// url where the project is hosted

experimentalClearLocaleDirs.description: If true, clear locale directories before writing translations

clearLocaleDirsExclude.description: Array of glob patterns with [locale] or [locales] placeholder to exclude from clearing (e.g., './snippets/[locale]/preserved/**' or './[locales]/static/**')

autoDetectBranches.description: Detect the current branch with git

remoteName.description: Git remote used to detect branches

conditionNames.description: Export conditions to check when resolving monorepo packages
